Half Harlem Globetrotters, half Washington Generals, commemorating 75 years of the rivalry that started it all. To pick up your exclusive game ball, visit the Harlem Globetrotters Merchandise Stand located inside the venue on game day. Pick-up is only available during pre-game, half-time, or post-game. Ball MUST be picked up at the venue on the date of your ticketed event. No alternate pick-up dates, locations, nor shipping options are available. This purchase is NON TRANSFERABLE.

events.name: MVP Court Pass (CHECK IN BY 2:30pm)
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

presales.name: Citi® Cardmember Presale
presales.description: To access the sale, use the first 6 digits of your eligible Citi® credit card or Citibank Debit Card as your presale code. You will also need to use your Citi® card to successfully complete your purchase.

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court --hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give your permission to use your likeness. ATTENTION! - Tech CU Arena enforces a restricted bag policy for all events.

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-Court Access from 1:30PM-2:00PM
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

venues.name: SAP Center at San Jose

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Ticket Office, located at the South East corner of the Arena, on the corner of Santa Clara St and Barack Obama Blvd, is open on event days 2hrs prior to event until the end of 2nd intermission for hockey or intermission for other events.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts Cash, Visa, Mastercard, Discover Card and American Express as methods of payment.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is available two hours prior to the start of the event. Will call is part of the South Ticket Office, on Barack Obama Blvd near Santa Clara St. Customers must present the actual credit card used for the purchase, a photo ID and the Ticketmaster confirmation number in order to receive their tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking at SAP Center is convenient but limited, with a select number of on-site spaces available for event guests. Pre purchasing parking is recommended to guarantee parking on event day. Pricing varies depending on the event, so guests are encouraged to plan ahead. In addition to on-site options, there are numerous public and private parking lots located within walking distance of the arena. SAP Center managed lots accept a variety of payment methods, including credit cards, mobile pay, and prepaid parking passes; however, cash is not accepted at any of these locations. Oversized vehicles such as RVs and stretch limousines are welcome but must pay for each space they occupy. Bus parking is also available on Barack Obama Boulevard.Sorry, no RV parking available.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: SAP Center has designated seats for both wheelchair accessible seating and their companions. However, due to size constraints, companion seats will not fit a wheelchair. So patrons needing wheelchair accessible seating must purchase a wheelchair accessible seat as the SAP Center cannot turn a companion seat into a wheelchair accessible seat.

generalInfo.generalRule: ***UPDATE *** ENHANCED SECURITY MEASURES! SAP Center at San Jose, Silicon Valley Sports & Entertainment, law enforcement agencies and the NHL have announced changes in Security measures for all Guests attending events at SAP Center. All Guests will be subject to search, which may include the use of Electronic devices, pat downs and inspections of bags. Only small purses and baby bags will be permitted in the Building. Guests are discouraged from bringing unnecessary items to SAP Center Events. * Shoes & shirts are required at all times within the building. * No audio or video recorders are allowed in the arena for any event. * There is no smoking allowed anywhere inside the arena. There are designated smoking sections provided outside of the arena.
generalInfo.childRule: All ages are welcome. For most events no ticket is required for ages 0-23 months, as long as they do not require a seat of their own. For events such as "Sesame Street", "Barney", or "Dragon Tales" a ticket is required for anyone 12 months or older.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Ticket Office, located at the South East corner of the Arena, on the corner of Santa Clara St and Barack Obama Blvd, is open on event days 2hrs prior to event until the end of 2nd intermission for hockey or intermission for other events.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts Cash, Visa, Mastercard, Discover Card and American Express as methods of payment.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is available two hours prior to the start of the event. Will call is part of the South Ticket Office, on Barack Obama Blvd near Santa Clara St. Customers must present the actual credit card used for the purchase, a photo ID and the Ticketmaster confirmation number in order to receive their tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking at SAP Center is convenient but limited, with a select number of on-site spaces available for event guests. Pre purchasing parking is recommended to guarantee parking on event day. Pricing varies depending on the event, so guests are encouraged to plan ahead. In addition to on-site options, there are numerous public and private parking lots located within walking distance of the arena. SAP Center managed lots accept a variety of payment methods, including credit cards, mobile pay, and prepaid parking passes; however, cash is not accepted at any of these locations. Oversized vehicles such as RVs and stretch limousines are welcome but must pay for each space they occupy. Bus parking is also available on Barack Obama Boulevard.Sorry, no RV parking available.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: SAP Center has designated seats for both wheelchair accessible seating and their companions. However, due to size constraints, companion seats will not fit a wheelchair. So patrons needing wheelchair accessible seating must purchase a wheelchair accessible seat as the SAP Center cannot turn a companion seat into a wheelchair accessible seat.

generalInfo.generalRule: ***UPDATE *** ENHANCED SECURITY MEASURES! SAP Center at San Jose, Silicon Valley Sports & Entertainment, law enforcement agencies and the NHL have announced changes in Security measures for all Guests attending events at SAP Center. All Guests will be subject to search, which may include the use of Electronic devices, pat downs and inspections of bags. Only small purses and baby bags will be permitted in the Building. Guests are discouraged from bringing unnecessary items to SAP Center Events. * Shoes & shirts are required at all times within the building. * No audio or video recorders are allowed in the arena for any event. * There is no smoking allowed anywhere inside the arena. There are designated smoking sections provided outside of the arena.
generalInfo.childRule: All ages are welcome. For most events no ticket is required for ages 0-23 months, as long as they do not require a seat of their own. For events such as "Sesame Street", "Barney", or "Dragon Tales" a ticket is required for anyone 12 months or older.
